# COUNTS: first touches of the lc-levels-hold KEEP levels and the imbalance flags (no outcome column; generated by `run_filter.py counts`)

DEV only: UTC days 2022-04-01..2024-06-30, 1m bars with open < 2024-07-01. Level blocks equal a 40-day window on 3 seeded days: 2023-02-04 (24 levels) equal; 2023-03-29 (23 levels) equal; 2023-11-21 (28 levels) equal.

- Touch events (deduplicated, one per level price and day): **5976** on 818 days; H1 2475, H2 3501.
- Skipped and counted: incomplete days 0; levels seen 19277; touched 5976; touched but side ambiguous (previous close equals the level) 0.
- Median width 0.400 % of price (cost 0.14 % = 0.35 R at the median).
